impact.text: the contract will reject new stakes even when the actual amount under management is well below the limit

precondition_sources.text: StakingManager has a stakingLimit parameter controlling the maximum HYPE tokens that could be staked in the system.
A total slashed amount exists for the StakingManager that is not accounted for in netStaked.

intent_sources.text: netStaked used in the stakingLimit check must account for the total slashed amount so it reflects the actual amount of tokens under management.
When the actual amount under management is below stakingLimit, new stakes within the limit should not be rejected.
